themes.quote: We continue to focus on funding and liquidity management to support our business operations and maintain strong capital levels
We maintain rigorous credit underwriting standards and actively monitor portfolio quality across our lending businesses
We use derivative instruments, including interest rate swaps and options, to manage our exposure to changes in interest rates
We actively manage our investment securities portfolio to balance yield, duration, and liquidity objectives
We continue to focus on improving operational efficiency and managing expenses in a controlled manner
we have committed to growing our dividend and maintaining our strong capital position, including through share buybacks
we continue to invest in digital capabilities and technology to enhance our clients' experience and operational efficiency
we are focused on growing our asset and wealth management business to serve high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients
we have taken actions to manage our exposure to commercial real estate given current market conditions
we maintain a focus on our deposit base and liquidity management to support our lending and investment activities
investing in digital platforms and mobile capabilities to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency
deploying AI and machine learning technologies across business lines to improve decision-making and automate processes
growing asset management and advisory services to increase recurring fee income from high-net-worth clients
